pages.text: Right-click a $(item)Recipe Tome$(). Shift-click an inventory item or drop an item from EMI/JEI onto the page, then press $(bold)Inscribe$().$(br2)Put the tome into a $(item)Chiseled Bookshelf$() inside network coverage.$(br2)A small star marks craftable products in the Nexus. Click an empty starred entry to select its amount, then press Enter or the hammer button. Shift-right-click explicitly requests a stack. These are additional items, even when some are already stored.

pages.title: Inscribe a recipe
pages.text: Review the output, processing method, machine, and ingredients, then press Inscribe.

Place a crafting table inside network coverage for autocrafting. The Nexus's personal grid is a separate manual workspace. Supply furnaces, brewing stands, or stonecutters for other processes. Extra tables add capacity. Visual Workbench keeps its saved grid untouched.$(br2)Intermediate recipes resolve automatically. Furnaces need fuel.$(br2)Jobs at the lower right show amounts and progress. Click a job's cross to cancel.
pages.title: Supply the workshop
Machine recipes
pages.text: Place compatible machines inside network coverage. Native tech recipes use their real item and fluid ports, co-products, and fuel.$(br2)Supply the normal power, heat, structure, tools, and catalysts. The Tome identifies the process and nearby machine.$(br2)Powah energizing runs one recipe at a time, with one ingredient per orb input slot. Larger requests repeat that cycle.

pages.title: Direct transport
pages.text: Ingredients travel from their actual storage to the processor. Products travel back to storage.$(br2)Each leg needs clear sight. Glass passes; opaque blocks obstruct. Visible relays can route around a wall.$(br2)Flights round relay corners within half a block of their centers. A Nexus can relay a transfer, but is not a required stop.

pages.title: Calculating and missing
pages.text: A request appears immediately as $(bold)Calculating$(). Recipe searches are cached and planned in the background.$(br2)Missing jobs show ingredient icons and counts. Click one for the shortage grid. A $(bold)#$() marks a recipe tag; hover to see its ID.$(br2)Supply matching ingredients to resume the same job.

pages.title: Arriving ingredients
pages.text: Workstations wait for deliveries. Tables display each arriving batch, then assemble once all ingredients arrive.$(br2)Furnaces receive real inputs and fuel after their flights finish. Fuel burns and smelting runs normally.$(br2)Instant automatic logistics removes delivery waits; it does not accelerate furnace cooking.
